title: ZisK — Host
description: One host, from node_exporter: CPU, memory, NUMA, disks, network and hardware

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Memory not available to new allocations without swapping

panels.title: Shared memory
panels.description: Memory in shm segments and tmpfs, the workers' /dev/shm segments among them

panels.title: Fullest filesystem
panels.description: The disk-backed filesystem nearest to full

panels.title: OOM kills
panels.description: Processes the kernel killed for want of memory, over the selected range

panels.title: Memory errors (ECC)
panels.description: Errors the memory controllers reported since boot (EDAC)

panels.title: Hottest sensor
panels.description: The hottest of the host's hwmon temperature sensors (CPUs, board, disks); GPUs are on the GPUs dashboard

panels.title: Failed units
panels.description: systemd units in the failed state (needs node_exporter's --collector.systemd)

panels.title: Clock
panels.description: Whether the kernel's clock is synchronised (NTP): the cluster's logs and metrics compare times across hosts

panels.title: CPU busy by mode
panels.description: Share of all the host's CPUs; iowait is idle time waiting on disk

panels.title: Busy per CPU
panels.description: One row per logical CPU, from CPU 0 at the bottom. On a host with several sockets, `lscpu` lists each NUMA node's CPUs, and the Busy per socket chart adds them up

panels.title: Busy per socket
panels.description: Needs node_exporter's --collector.cpu.info, which labels each CPU with its socket

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (package) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{host="$host",mode!="idle"}[1m]) * on (cpu) group_left (package) node_cpu_info{host="$host"}) / count by (package) (node_cpu_info{host="$host"})

panels.title: Waiting for a resource (pressure)
panels.description: Linux pressure stall information: share of the time some (or all) runnable tasks waited for the CPU, memory or I/O

panels.title: Load
panels.description: Runnable (and uninterruptible) tasks; above the CPU count, tasks queue for a CPU

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Where the host's memory goes. Shared memory includes the workers' /dev/shm segments

panels.title: Memory per NUMA node
panels.description: Needs node_exporter's --collector.meminfo_numa. A node that fills up sends its allocations to the other socket's memory

panels.title: Allocations off their NUMA node
panels.description: Needs node_exporter's --collector.meminfo_numa. Pages (4 KiB) a task on one socket got from the other socket's memory

targets.legendFormat: node {{node}}: placed here, meant for another
node {{node}}: placed here, for a task on another

panels.title: Paging and swapping
panels.description: Per second. Major faults while proving mean the working set does not fit in memory

panels.title: Filesystems
panels.description: Disk-backed filesystems

panels.title: Disk busy
panels.description: Share of the time each device had I/O in flight

panels.title: TCP retransmissions
panels.description: Share of the TCP segments sent again: the coordinator's and the workers' connections run over TCP

panels.title: Failed units
panels.description: systemd units in the failed state (needs node_exporter's --collector.systemd)

panels.title: Clock offset
panels.description: The kernel clock's offset from its NTP source
